item.title: [LU-21225] conf-sanity test_134: check_iam errcode does not fit with errors in b2_16 interop
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for Patrickbot <patrick-bot@mulberrytree.us>

This issue relates to the following test suite run: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/fc8cc202-925e-40d0-9b46-e9795f90507d

test_134 failed with the following error:

check_iam errcode does not fit with errors 0 71

Test session details:

Interop

Client
Lustre: 2.17.61.144
Branch: master-next
Build: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-master-next/1026
Kernel: 7.0.0-22-generic

Server
Lustre: 2.16.1.2
Branch: b2_16
Build: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-b2_16/6
Kernel: 5.14.0-427.31.1_lustre.el9.x86_64

conf-sanity test_134 "check_iam works without faults" fails every run in the b2_16 server interop configuration (master client/tests with b2_16 servers, test group full-part-3 on lustre-master and lustre-master-next, and lustre-reviews custom serverversion=2.16 sessions). In the last 30 days it failed 77 of 77 such branch runs, versus 0 failures in the 467 same-group runs with master servers. No ticket links these failures.

Error: "check_iam errcode does not fit with errors 0 N" (N varies, 53 to 71). The test counts corrupted IAM files by pdsh exit code 255 (rc_corrupted) and compares it with the number of "FINISHED WITH ERRORS" lines in the output. With b2_16 servers rc_corrupted stays 0 while check_iam reports errors for the LFSCK and nodemap files, so the exit status of the remote command is not seen as 255. The test also treats the files as present on 2.16.0+ servers (LU-18401), so b2_16 development version numbering may be a factor.

Example: https://testing.whamcloud.com/sub_tests/bbaf00cb-d62e-487d-b8ff-89bc8ae589eb
Seen also on change 54749 (LU-17740 mds: remove user_xattr,acl MDT options), session a090ab6d-4726-41a7-92b0-b51118af94e8 (PS16), whose patch does not touch the test or check_iam; the same failure occurs without it.

Raised by Patch Watcher run pw-engineer-54749-ps16-af9ab8df6a90 on https://review.whamcloud.com/54749
